# Reporting a security problem

If you believe you have found a security problem in a Dnyx Academy website, in Dnyx Learn, or in
anything in this organisation, please tell us before telling anyone else.

- Use the contact form at [dnyxacademy.com/contact](https://dnyxacademy.com/contact) and say it is a
  security report.
- Include what you found, the URL or repository, and the steps to reproduce it.
- Please do not open a public issue, and please do not test against other people's accounts or data.

We will acknowledge your report and tell you what we have done about it.

**Learners:** if you have committed a key, token or password to a repository, this is the same
process — tell your mentor the same day and rotate the key. It is a normal mistake and you will not
be penalised for reporting it.
